description: LIVE: split size_usd into steps equal orders across the price range price_from to price_to. A buy fills from the top level down as the price falls; a sell from the bottom level up as it rises. Felix runs it: each step is a live market order under this key when the price reaches its level, within the key's caps and risk rules, so this moves real money until it completes, expires (default 24 hours) or you cancel_twap. Each fill is bounded by slippage_bps from the quote at send time. Each step must be at least $10. idempotency_key is required; the same key always returns the same order. Follow progress with get_twap.

expires_minutes.description: Optional: cancel the rest after this many minutes, 1 to 43200 (default 1440).

idempotency_key.description: Required retry-safety key (8-128 characters). The same key always means the same order.

instrument.description: perp:SYM or lighter:SYM, for example perp:BTC.

leverage.description: Optional leverage, default 1, up to the venue maximum.

price_from.description: One end of the price range.

price_to.description: The other end of the price range.

reduce_only.description: Only reduce an existing position; never open or flip.

size_usd.description: Total notional in USD across all steps (at least $10 per step).

slippage_bps.description: Optional worst fill vs the quote at send time for each step, 1 to 10000 basis points.

name: start_scale_order
